skill_friction: Already-met case with a small defect in the existing component (divide-by-zero in Average_Review_Score__c for 2 zero-review storefronts): SKILL.md says both 'name only real gaps' / 'the inventory covers only the verified gap' and 'do not add nearby enhancements'. It does not say whether a defect in an existing component that affects only an edge case (no reviews) counts as a gap to fix or a proposal; I chose a Section 8 proposal and a zero-change spec.

Step 6 says skip I when verification shows the requirement is met, but it is not explicit whether step 5's intent question (Submitted vs Published status filter, raised by AskCoworker as blocking) must still be considered; I resolved it from the requirement wording ('whenever a review comes in') per step 5's 'intent answered by wording' rule.

AskCoworker gave three wrong 'not queryable' claims (formula body, roll-up filters, validation rules). The two-wrong-claims rule triggered 'verify every AskCoworker fact the spec keeps'; the one kept unverified fact (AgentSummarizeReviewsActions behavior) was tagged reported by AskCoworker although its body was fetched only for field names. The rule is ambiguous about whether a peripheral kept fact must be fully verified or can be dropped.
